evidence.title: Coarse Indexing, Fine Evidence: Decoupling Temporal Granularity in Long-Video RAG

summary: A new study introduces a method to separate coarse and fine temporal indexing in long-video Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enhancing evidence retrieval accuracy. The approach aims to optimize AI systems handling extended video content.
title: Researchers Decouple Temporal Granularity in Long-Video RAG for Improved AI Retrieval
